card.name: Verbs after God in Christian scripture
card.fires_on: Auxiliary or main verbs right after God, He, or the Father as subject in Christian scripture commentary, especially about Jesus's resurrection and fulfilled promises (hath, has, would, will).

modes.label: Verb after God/He
modes.description: Verb such as hath, has, will or would following God, He or the Father as subject.
modes.example: "God hath fulfilled the same unto us their children, in that He<< hath>> raised up Jesus; as it is also

modes.label: Passive or linking words in salvation passages
modes.description: Words like been, being, or that in sentences about sanctification or what God did.
modes.example: By that will we have<< been>> sanctified through the offering of the body
